newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: WMC sells Hill 50 to Wattle Gully.
newsitem.headline: WMC sells Hill 50 to Wattle Gully.

text.p: WMC Ltd said on Thursday it reached agreement with Vadessa Pty Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Wattle Gully Gold Mines NL, to sell to it all of the issued share capital of Hill 50 Gold Mine NL and some related mining tenements.
The purchase price of the shares and tenements is A$15.005 million plus an adjustment for the net current assets of Hill 50 as at July 1, 1997, the effective date of the transaction, WMC said.
Hill 50 owns and operates the Hill 50 gold mine at Mt Magnet in Western Australia.
The sale is conditional upon the acquisition being approved by Wattle Gully's shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting which is expected to be held late in June, WMC said.
Settlement of the transaction is expected to be concluded in July.

Meanwhile, the Australian Stock Exchange said it suspended trading, effective immediately, in the shares of Wattle Gully at the company's request until such time as the ASX's requirements concerning the acquisition are satisfied.
